outcome_statistics_seen_at_declaration: none for C-ATTACK. Prior knowledge from closed C studies is listed in prior_knowledge and is the reason for the hypothesis, not a tuning input.
status_of_c_family: STRATEGY C DIRECTIONAL FAMILY = CLOSED (C_FAMILY_CLOSEOUT_V1.md). This declaration does not reopen it and changes no C rule, threshold, taxonomy, window or result.
question: Can the right-tail frequency increase observed in C-M0 M_ONLY candidates be converted into realized, cost-aware, gap-aware, conservatively ordered positive expectancy with an asymmetric take-profit / stop-loss exit, better than matched high-volatility controls under the identical exit?

prior_knowledge.c_m_gate_c2: FAIL; 10D +15% MFE matched lift 1.358, 10D close excess -0.06pp (CI contains 0)
prior_knowledge.c_e0_m_only: 10D +15% MFE hit 30.28% vs matched control 20.07%; 5D close excess +0.319pp [-0.588, +1.075]; MAE5 excess -2.13pp
prior_knowledge.c_v2b: volatility expansion; log-return downside >= upside; ~90% of sub-sample volatility excess vanishes when D-day true range is controlled
prior_knowledge.use: motivation only; no threshold below was chosen from these numbers except that +15% / 10D was already the C headline tail metric

candidate.c_m0: frozen C-M0 variant of c_m_selection_rules_v1.json, primary evaluation window (signal-date index 251..N-10 on the 501-session grid = 2025-09-18..2026-09-01, 240 dates). The run must reproduce candidates_primary digest 64e57203... before anything else.
candidate.m_only: C-M0 primary candidate rows whose C-E0 status (c_e0_rules_v1 assignment order, W_PRIMARY) is M_ONLY. EM, EM_NEGATIVE_RISK, EXCLUDED_MA_TARGET and UNKNOWN_* rows are not traded in the primary test.

m_only_source.accepted_A: data/runtime/strategy_c/e0/runs/ce01-234478e8f7ff27570e13/candidate_status.parquet copied byte-for-byte from the PC that produced C-E0; its (signal_date, ticker) set must equal the reproduced C-M0 primary rows and its status counts must equal c_e0_published_status_counts exactly
m_only_source.accepted_B: status recomputed with the unmodified strategy_c_e0 code (cohorts.assign) over an EDGAR submissions store; accepted only if status counts equal c_e0_published_status_counts exactly; the store digest is recorded
m_only_source.otherwise: BLOCKED_M_ONLY_SOURCE: no outcome is computed and no gate value exists

candidate.secondary_descriptive: all C-M0 primary candidates (every status) under the same exits; never a gate input
candidate.no_rule_changes: no C-M threshold, bucket, eligibility, CA rule or C-E0 window/taxonomy is modified

entry.rule: buy at open(D+1), D = signal date. The candidate exists only after close(D).
entry.price_basis: split-normalized: raw price(t) / F(t), F(t) = cumulative price factor of splits executed <= t (C-M panel contract). Entry E = open(D+1)/F(D+1).
forbidden: any later or better price chosen after seeing the path
entry.no_entry_bar: no bar or open <= 0 on D+1 -> NO_ENTRY (not a trade; counted per group)

exits.primary_pair_rationale: +15% is the C headline tail metric already used before; -7% gives payoff ratio 2.14 without choosing from any C-ATTACK result
exits.non_primary_pairs: reported in every table; never a gate input; the best pair is never promoted
exits.levels: TP = E * (1 + tp), SL = E * (1 - sl), fixed at entry
exits.holding_window: sessions D+1..D+10 on the XNYS grid (D+1 is the entry session)
per_session_order: session without a bar for the ticker: no exit possible, continue (counted as missing_session)
sessions D+2..D+10: if open <= SL -> exit at open (SL_FIRST, gap_through_sl); elif open >= TP -> exit at open (TP_FIRST, gap_through_tp; resting limit fills at the better open)
then intraday: high >= TP and low <= SL -> AMBIGUOUS_SAME_BAR; low <= SL only -> SL_FIRST at SL; high >= TP only -> TP_FIRST at TP
D+1 (entry session): no gap rule (the open is the entry); intraday rule applies to the D+1 bar

ambiguous_same_bar.primary_conservative: treated as SL_FIRST, exit at SL (stop-type exit costs apply)
ambiguous_same_bar.optimistic_diagnostic: treated as TP_FIRST, exit at TP; descriptive and used only for the INCONCLUSIVE rule, never to pass the gate

exits.no_bar_on_d10: if still open and the ticker has a later bar in the panel: exit at the first later open (if that open <= SL it is SL_FIRST gap_through_sl, if >= TP it is TP_FIRST gap_through_tp, else NEITHER with late_exit flag)
exits.delisted_or_permanently_suspended: if still open and the ticker has no bar after its last bar (last bar < D+10 or no bar on/after D+10): exit at last available close * (1 - 0.30) (delist haircut 30%, primary); state NEITHER with delisted flag. Sensitivity 0% and 100% haircut is descriptive.
exits.stop_fill_realism: intraday stop fills at exactly SL; the extra stop slippage in the cost model is the only adjustment

corporate_actions.contract: C-M PIT/corporate-action contract reused unchanged: split-normalized prices with F(t); candidate and control ticker-dates with split_flag or ca_suspect excluded by C-M0 eligibility; label_ca_suspect (split-normalized open(D+1)/close(D), close(t)/close(t-1), open(t)/close(t-1) for t in D+2..D+10 >= 3.0 or <= 1/3) excludes the trade for candidates AND controls, counted per group
corporate_actions.ca_stress_descriptive: label_ca_suspect candidate trades re-included at min(simulated return, -sl - costs); descriptive

costs.reason: no common project cost model covers $3+ high-volatility names with stop exits; Strategy E COST grid (5-20bp, $5+ universe) is strategy-specific and explicitly not sufficient for lower-priced names
costs.form: net_return = gross_return - round_trip_cost; round_trip_cost = commission + spread_slippage(price bucket) + low_adv_add + stop_extra(if stop-type exit)

spread_slippage_round_trip_by_price_buck.note: price bucket = C-M price_bucket of raw close(D) (edges 3,5,10,20,50,100), known at close(D)

stop_extra.applies_to: SL_FIRST intraday, SL_FIRST gap_through_sl, AMBIGUOUS treated as SL

costs.applied_to: candidates and controls identically, each with its own buckets and exit type

matched_control.population: C-M0 eligible ticker-dates (hard filter + base history + CA exclusions) on the same signal date minus ALL C-M0 candidates (any C-E0 status), with a trade-valid entry (entry bar, not label_ca_suspect)
matched_control.exit: identical pair, ordering, gap, neither, delist and cost rules
matched_control.base_for_a_candidate: mean net return (and each rate) of the trade-valid controls in its cell
matched_control.unmatched: candidate trades in cells with < 5 controls are excluded from H2 and counted; they stay in H1

metrics_per_pair: expectancy (= mean net return per trade)
top1/top5/top10 trade contribution (sum of top-k net returns / total net P&L)
worst trade, p1, p5, loss beyond nominal SL

capital_model.sleeve_portfolio: capital 1.0, non-compounding; 10 sleeves (one per holding session); each signal date's trades share 1/10 of initial capital equally; each trade's P&L = weight * net return, booked on its exit session; equity = 1 + cumulative booked P&L; drawdown = equity / running peak - 1. At most 10 open cohorts -> gross exposure <= 100%, no infinite capital.
capital_model.trade_order_for_streaks: exit session, then signal date, then ticker
concurrency_report: open positions per session: max, median, p95
capital_model.portfolio_attack_simulation: only if H1 and H2 both pass: capital 100, compounding, risk 0.5% of equity per trade (notional = 0.005 * equity / sl), gross exposure cap 100% (new entries skipped in signal_date, ticker order when exceeded). Descriptive, no sizing search, never a gate input.

statistics.bootstrap: moving block bootstrap over the 240 signal dates, block length 10, 10000 replicates, seed 20260921 (C-E0 construction: per-date sums, dates are the resampling unit)
statistics.gate_statistic: H2 = mean over matched candidate trades of (candidate net return - cell control mean net return), primary pair, conservative ordering; two-sided 95% percentile CI
statistics.reported: H1 95%/99% CI, H2 99% CI, median, 5% trimmed mean; no multiplicity correction because there is exactly one gate statistic

hypotheses.H1: primary pair net expectancy (all trade-valid M_ONLY trades, conservative ordering) > 0
hypotheses.H2: primary pair net expectancy of candidates > matched control net expectancy (gate statistic CI low > 0)
hypotheses.H4: sleeve-portfolio max drawdown of the primary pair (net, conservative) <= 25%

time_blocks: 4 consecutive blocks of the 240 signal dates (np.array_split; same as C-M/C-E0: 2025-09-18..12-11, 12-12..2026-03-11, 03-12..06-05, 06-08..09-01)

conditions.6_gap_aware: satisfied only because conditions 1-5 are computed with gap-through exits at the open; recorded, not separately tested
conditions.7_conservative_ambiguity: satisfied only because conditions 1-5 use AMBIGUOUS = SL_FIRST; recorded, not separately tested
conditions.8_time_stability: H2 excess point > 0 in >= 3 of 4 blocks AND H1 point > 0 after removing the block with the largest net P&L
conditions.9_concentration: sum of the top-10 trade net returns <= 50% of total net P&L (total must be > 0) AND H1 point > 0 after removing the 5 tickers with the largest total net P&L
conditions.10_sample: trade-valid candidate trades >= 300 AND matched candidate trades >= 300 AND unique tickers >= 100
conditions.11_pit: PIT violations == 0 including determinism and a detected positive control

decision.BLOCKED_M_ONLY_SOURCE: M_ONLY source not verified; no gate value
decision.INCONCLUSIVE: condition 10 or 11 fails (sample / data integrity), OR conditions 1-9 fail under conservative ordering, the primary pair AMBIGUOUS share of candidate trades > 0.25, and conditions 1-5, 8, 9 would all pass with AMBIGUOUS = TP_FIRST (minute ordering would decide)
decision.FAIL: otherwise. Poor returns are never INCONCLUSIVE.

after_pass: minute ordering refinement (separate phase, subset with minute coverage, only AMBIGUOUS trades) -> execution cost -> portfolio risk sizing -> OOS / forward shadow -> paper -> live. No live trading from V0.
after_fail: C Stable Directional = FAIL and C Attack Tail Harvest = FAIL: Strategy C long-side research ends. Volatility-neutral / options only under a new strategy ID.
prohibited: re-adding event presence, event quality or analog F3
minute data in the primary gate
